purpose: Outer variadic evaluation warns on unknown missing CV before inner mapping. Unknown/duplicate mapping errors have only Closure::call, same-pack order fails before handler entry, inner count/type errors have internal Gen then outer Closure frames. Late named newThis maps correctly. Final computed call reuses the original Generator, discriminating temporary mode even when ordinary target equality also holds.
source:
<?php
function flow115A() { echo 'INIT|'; $value = yield 'head'; echo 'VALUE|', $value, '|'; yield 'tail'; }
function outer115A($error, $receiver) {
    $trace = $error->getTrace();
    echo $trace[0]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'call', '|', $trace[0]['args'][0] === $receiver, '|', !isset($trace[1]), '|';
}
$old = flow115A(); $receiver = flow115A(); $send = $old->send(...); $throw = $old->throw(...);
set_error_handler(function($level, $message) { echo 'WARN|', $message === 'Undefined variable $missing', '|'; return true; });
try { echo 'UNKNOWN|'; $send->call($receiver, extra: $missing); }
catch (Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage() === 'Unknown named parameter $extra', '|'; outer115A($error, $receiver); }
restore_error_handler();
try { echo 'COUNT|'; $send->call($receiver); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $error) { $trace = $error->getTrace(); echo $error->getMessage() === 'Generator::send() expects exactly 1 argument, 0 given', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Generator', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'send', '|', !isset($trace[0]['file']), '|', !isset($trace[0]['line']), '|', $trace[0]['args'] === [], '|', $trace[1]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'call', '|', $trace[1]['file'] === __FILE__, '|', $trace[1]['args'][0] === $receiver, '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|'; }
try { echo 'NAME-POS|'; $send->call($receiver, ...['value' => 41], ...[42]); }
catch (Error $error) { $trace = $error->getTrace(); echo $error->getMessage() === 'Named parameter $value overwrites previous argument', '|', $trace[0]['args'][1] === 42, '|', $trace[0]['args']['value'] === 41, '|'; outer115A($error, $receiver); }
try { echo 'PACK-ORDER|'; $send->call($receiver, ...['value' => 41, 0 => 42]); }
catch (Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage() === 'Cannot use positional argument after named argument during unpacking', '|', $error->getTrace() === [], '|'; }
try { echo 'TYPE|'; $throw->call($receiver, exception: 17); }
catch (TypeError $error) { $trace = $error->getTrace(); echo $error->getMessage() === 'Generator::throw(): Argument #1 ($exception) must be of type Throwable, int given', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Generator', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'throw', '|', !isset($trace[0]['file']), '|', !isset($trace[0]['line']), '|', $trace[0]['args'][0] === 17, '|', $trace[1]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'call', '|', $trace[1]['args'][0] === $receiver, '|', $trace[1]['args']['exception'] === 17, '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|'; }
try { echo 'NULL|'; $send->call(null, value: 41); }
catch (TypeError $error) { $trace = $error->getTrace(); echo $error->getMessage() === 'Closure::call(): Argument #1 ($newThis) must be of type object, null given', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'call', '|', !isset($trace[1]), '|'; }
unset($error, $trace);
$method = 'call'; echo 'VALID|', $send->{$method}(value: 41, newThis: $old), '|DONE|';
